frase_gancho.texto: Optional stop: Mario Moreno’s vacation home, with a Diego Rivera mosaic in the swimming pool.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: As an extra, optional stop, you can walk over to the house where Mario Moreno, Cantinflas, used to come to rest. It is on Benito Juárez Boulevard and does not always open, so you never know whether you will be able to go in. Among its gardens is a swimming pool decorated with a mosaic by Diego Rivera, who was a friend of the actor.
